---
title: Set Up Points
description: >-
  Configure point earning rules and build custom earning conditions tailored to
  specific member tiers.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1377" height="760" style="width: 1377px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

Step\
1. Navigate to Incentives > Points > Points Setting.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="269" height="246" style="width: 269px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Define points earning rules.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="464" height="257" style="width: 464px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3. Boost member rewards during their birth month by setting a multiplier on every purchase.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="413" height="284" style="width: 413px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

4. **Optional:&#x20;**&#x42;uild custom earning rules for specific member tiers or locations.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="436" height="361" style="width: 436px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
